title: iMode
description: iMode adds witchery by rituals and contracts; 4 new bosses and increases difficulty the further you are from spawn. Oh and a procedural generation dungeon.
body:
# iMode

iMode is a dark fantasy progression mod for Minecraft Forge 1.20.1. Its main goal is to make the world become more dangerous the farther players travel from spawn, creating a stronger sense of exploration, preparation, and survival pressure.

The mod adds distance-based difficulty zones, stronger mobs, custom progression, ritual magic, mana systems, spell scrolls, a Grimoire, contracts, custom dungeon generation, bosses, and witch-themed blocks/items.

Instead of only adding stronger gear, iMode focuses mostly on making the world harsher and more mysterious. Players are pushed to use rituals, magic, positioning, preparation, and outside progression tools to survive deeper zones.

## Important recommendation

iMode makes Minecraft significantly harder, but it does not yet fully provide all the gear, enchantments, weapons, or strengthening systems needed to compensate for that difficulty. For the best experience, it is recommended to play iMode alongside other mods that add stronger armor, weapons, enchantments, accessories, or player-strengthening mechanics.

## Current beta content

* Distance-based danger zones
* Zone-based mob scaling
* Custom iMode player progression
* Ritual magic using chalk glyphs, offerings, braziers, and rite books
* Mana and altar systems
* Spell scrolls and Grimoire spell management
* Contracts and contract-related mechanics
* Underground procedural dungeons from Zone 4+
* Custom bosses and mobs
* Witch-themed blocks, furniture, and items

## Beta warning

This is an early beta. Balance is not final, and many systems are still being expanded or reworked. Dungeons, bosses, rituals, contracts, spells, mob scaling, loot, and progression may change heavily between versions.

A new world is recommended.
